title: Isamaya Ffrench no longer affiliated with namesake beauty brand
summary: The make-up artist has allegedly distanced herself from her own cosmetics brand, Isamaya Beauty, with rumours stating she has not been involved with the brand for more than a year

extraction.key_fact: 메이크업 아티스트 이사마야 프렌치가 자신의 이름을 딴 화장품 브랜드와 결별했다는 소식이 전해졌다.
